newsitem.title: USA: Exploration oil well tests at 535 bbls/day.
newsitem.headline: Exploration oil well tests at 535 bbls/day.

text.p: The Exploration Co said Tuesday that it has drillstem tested 32 degree gravity oil at the rate of 535 barrels per day from the Sherry 1-16 in the Red River formation in Bowman County, North Dakota.
Exploration Co said it owns the entire working interest in the well that will be completed as soon as the casing is cemented and the drilling rig moves off the location.

A drillstem test, which is effectively a temporary completion to test for production from a particular zone while the drilling rig is on location, recovered 7,269 feet of heavily gas-cut oil in the drill pipe (approximately 55 barrels) during the 2.5 hour test, which calculates to be a rate of 535 barrels per day, said the company.
Exploration Co owns about 300,000 net acres in the Williston Basin in Bowman, Slope, Stark and Golden Valley counties of North Dakota and Harding County, South Dakota.
The company is an oil and gas enterprise with interests in Texas, North Dakota and Montana.
